name: Barbed Devil

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, the barbed devil deals 3 (1d6) Piercing damage to any creature Grappling it.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Tail.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is Grappled (escape DC 14) unless the devil is already grappling a creature.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

description: Barbed devils stand as sentinels of the Nine Hells, their spiked hides punishing any creature foolish enough to grapple them while their claws pin victims in place for the tail's finishing blow.
